overview.en:
Query Google Ads accounts, campaign performance and GAQL metadata through Google’s official read-only MCP.

Analyze Ads account and campaign reporting through the read-only integration. Keep account scope, dates, and GAQL fields explicit; this connection is for querying rather than editing campaigns.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方只读 MCP 查询 Ads 账号、广告系列表现与 GAQL 元数据。

通过只读集成分析 Ads 账号与广告系列报表，明确账号范围、日期和 GAQL 字段；此连接用于查询，不用于修改广告系列。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Compare campaign spend and performance for the last seven days.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较最近七天广告系列的支出与表现。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a GAQL query for this reporting question and explain the fields.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个报表问题准备 GAQL 查询，并解释字段。

starterPrompts.en: Investigate the available evidence for this campaign's performance change.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 调查这个广告系列表现变化的可用依据。

descriptions.en: Use Google Ads in Ghast. Query Google Ads accounts, campaign performance and GAQL metadata through Google’s official read-only MCP. 通过 Google 官方只读 MCP 查询 Ads 账号、广告系列表现与 GAQL 元数据。
